explanation: Advance a pair holding consecutive Fibonacci numbers until the requested index is reached.
correctness: Initially the pair is F(0), F(1). Replacing it with its second value and its sum advances both indices by one.
walkthrough: For n=6, start with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1. Advancing the two running values produces 1, 2, 3, 5 and 8 for indices 2 through 6. The required result is 8; there is no recursive tree of repeated work.
edgeCases: F(0)=0 and F(1)=1; the maximum supported result is F(46)=1836311903.
timeComplexity: O(n+1) time: a constant-size pair advances at most n times; n=0 takes constant work.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space: only consecutive values and a loop counter are stored; the bounded bank domain uses fixed-width-size values.
